name: brave
title: Brave
description: Search open tabs, bookmarks and history in Brave.
author: ron-myers

commands.name: open-new-incognito-window
commands.title: Open New Incognito Window
commands.description: Open a new Brave incognito window.

commands.name: search-tab
commands.title: Search Tabs
commands.description: List all tabs and go to the selected.

preferences.name: useOriginalFavicon
preferences.title: Favicon (macOS only)
preferences.label: Extract the favicon from every open tab
preferences.description: Before enable this, you should enable 'View > Developer > Allow JavaScript from Apple Events' in every Brave profile.

preferences.name: openTabInProfile
preferences.title: Open Tab In Profile
preferences.description: When 'Default(classic), the tab will be opened in the profile open, or topmost profile window if multiple windows are open. When 'Current Profile', the tab will be opened in the profile specified in the 'Profile' field. When 'Original Profile' it will open in original profile tab is sourced from

preferences.name: browserOption
preferences.title: Brave Browser Option
preferences.description: Select the Brave Browser you want to use.

preferences.name: bravePath
preferences.title: Brave Executable (Windows)
preferences.description: Optional full path to brave.exe for custom or portable installations. Overrides browser channel selection for launching.

preferences.name: userDataPath
preferences.title: User Data Directory (Windows)
preferences.description: Optional path to the User Data folder containing Local State and profile folders for a custom or portable installation.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
